query:
SELECT u.id,
                      u.username,
                      u.email,
                      u.password_hash,
                      u.change_id    as "change_id: Vec<u8>",
                      u.is_active    as "is_active: bool",
                      GROUP_CONCAT(ur.role_slug) as "roles_csv: Option<String>"
               FROM users u
               LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id
               GROUP BY u.id
               ORDER BY u.id
